messages:
Maya: Quick UX/design note — the in-product docs panel we added on the Models page has a few consistency/copy/accessibility nits I ran into while testing. Posting quick thread so we can decide what to fix before the next patch.

Kevin: thanks — can you list the high-level items? low-effort wins first please.

Maya: sure. short list: 1) terminology mismatch: docs say "route" but console uses "endpoint" in a bunch of places. confuses new users. 2) cross-links: docs panel shows step list but no direct deep links to the API reference or SDK snippets. 3) copy: CTA in panel is "Run" but our docs use "Generate" — we should pick one. 4) accessibility: keyboard focus on the panel close button is very subtle, and the dark grey on dark blue fails contrast on some text.

Sarah: re terminology — +1 to standardize. I vote for "endpoint" in product text and add "(route)" in docs for searchability. That keeps console familiar for infra folks.

Alex: From docs POV: we can add an "Open in docs" link at the top of the panel that jumps to the relevant section and anchors the correct heading. Downsides: we need stable anchors. We can auto-generate anchors based on model id + section slug.

Toni: accessibility nits: I reproduced the contrast issue (chrome devtools audit). We should: - increase text contrast for the panel header and CTA - ensure close button has visible focus ring and aria-label="Close docs panel" - add skip link so keyboard users can jump to the examples.

Kevin: re anchors — can we keep anchors stable across doc rewrites? If not, maybe deep-link to a search query fallback.

Alex: yep — plan: prefer stable anchors (we have them for /docs/reference/*), fallback to query: "/docs?q=model:gh-123+panel:examples". I'll add a small redirect helper.

docs-bot: Automated note: existing docs page "/docs/models/serve#panel-examples" currently has heading id "panel-examples".

Maya: Copy suggestion for CTA: change "Run" -> "Generate sample" for clarity on Models/Console. Short, but avoids ambiguous "Run". Thoughts?

Sarah: +1 on "Generate sample". Longer but clearer. Also suggest updating small helper text: "Use the SDK snippet below to run this example" -> "Use the SDK or REST snippet below to generate sample output".

Kevin: engineering checklist: (a) canonicalize term to "endpoint" in UI strings (b) add top-right "Open in docs" link with anchor fallback (c) update CTA copy + translations (d) accessibility fixes Toni listed. Estimate: 2 dev-days + 1 QA day.

Toni: I'll create the accessibility ticket and attach the failing Axe screenshots. Also note: ensure color token used is from design system so we don't accidentally set ad-hoc hex.

Alex: doc change plan: add anchors and a tiny "open-in-console" note on the docs page so linking is bi-directional. PR incoming.

Maya: Great. Small follow-ups: can we add a tiny inline help icon on hover that shows the canonical term mapping (endpoint <-> route) so support can point people there?

Kevin: doable as a tooltip. Quick hack: use `title` attribute for now, we'll replace with accessible tooltip component later.

Maya: thanks team. I'll file a short design brief with screenshots and assign tickets: product (Maya), eng (Kevin), docs (Alex), a11y (Toni). Will post PR links here once created. :thumbsup:

Alex: quick note for the PR: include the snippet we used in the panel (JS + curl). Example block we can link to: ```js
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-3', prompt: 'hello' })
console.log(res.output)
```

Toni: thanks — will review a11y changes in the dev preview.

Kevin: I'll scope the i18n impact, especially for CTA length. Might need small layout tweak.

Maya: perfect. closing the loop — thanks all.
